implemented_requirements.requirement: Player presses a key to flap and keep the bird from falling
implemented_requirements.evidence: Game.__init__ binds '<space>' and '<Up>' to self.flap(); Bird.flap() sets vertical velocity to FLAP_STRENGTH; Bird.update() applies gravity and updates position.

implemented_requirements.requirement: Randomly generated vertical gaps in pipes appear
implemented_requirements.evidence: Pipe.__init__ computes self.gap using random.gauss(base_gap, 18) bounded by MIN_GAP and base_gap+40, and selects self.gap_y with random.randint within play area.

implemented_requirements.requirement: Pipes move left across the screen
implemented_requirements.evidence: Game.update() calls pipe.update(self.speed) for each pipe; Pipe.update() subtracts speed from self.x.

implemented_requirements.requirement: Each successful pass of a pipe increases the score
implemented_requirements.evidence: Game.update() checks if not pipe.scored and pipe.x + pipe.width < bird.x, then sets pipe.scored = True and increments self.score.

implemented_requirements.requirement: Game ends if the bird collides with a pipe or the ground
implemented_requirements.evidence: Game.update() sets game_over when bird.y + radius >= HEIGHT - GROUND_H (ground collision) or when any(p.collides(self.bird.rect) for p in self.pipes) (pipe collision).

implemented_requirements.requirement: Difficulty gradually adjusts by varying gap sizes and pipe speeds
implemented_requirements.evidence: Game.apply_difficulty() updates self.speed = min(3.0 + score*0.08, 7.5) and self.base_gap = max(120, 175 - score*2), affecting new Pipe creation.

implemented_requirements.requirement: Visual rendering of bird, pipes, ground, and score
implemented_requirements.evidence: Bird.draw(), Pipe.draw(), and Game.draw() use tkinter Canvas methods to render all elements and display the current score.

judge.summary: The provided code implements a functional Flappy Bird clone using tkinter. All core gameplay mechanics—flapping, gravity, randomly sized pipe gaps, moving pipes, scoring, collision detection, ground handling, and progressive difficulty—are present and wired together. The code appears ready to run without missing components, yielding a high functional completeness and a strong likelihood of successful execution.
